summary: Unreadable characters in output from z/OS hosts usually come from an EBCDIC encoding mix-up. Check the remote environment and the file encodings on both the remote and control nodes.
questions: Why do I see garbage characters in playbook output from z/OS?
How do I troubleshoot encoding problems on z/OS UNIX?
Are untagged files on z/OS EBCDIC by default?

answer_card.title: Unreadable characters from z/OS hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
Garbled output is usually an EBCDIC encoding mix-up. Check that:
- the remote environment is set up correctly
- the expected file encodings are right on both the remote node and the control node

`ansible.builtin` modules assume UTF-8, while many z/OS UNIX systems default untagged files to EBCDIC. Data can end up not converted from EBCDIC, or wrongly converted when it is already UTF-8.
